protocol.description:
This protocol allows clients to claim a service by name, to associate the service name with the claiming client. Other clients may look up a service by name to obtain its identifier. A service name can have at most one active client at a time.
Claimed services are assigned an opaque identifier by the compositor. The identifier uniquely identifies the service across compositor instances for the lifetime of the compositor, remaining associated with the service until the claim is released. The method used to generate the service identifier is compositor-specific and must not be relied upon by clients.
A service claim is owned by the client that created it. The claim and its service identifier are automatically released by the compositor when the owning client disconnects, or the client explicitly releases it. Releasing a claim makes its corresponding service name available for a subsequent claim.

interface.name: service_registry_manager_v1

description.summary: Registry for claiming and discovering service names

interface.description: This interface allows clients to access the service registry to claim and lookup service names.

request.name: claim
request.description: Claim a service name for this client. The compositor will allocate a service identifier for this client that uniquely identifies the claim until the client disconnects, or the claim is explicitly released.

request.name: lookup

description.summary: Look up a service identifier by service name

request.description: Look up a service identifier by service name. The result of a lookup will be returned by the 'found' and 'not_found' events for successful and unsuccessful lookups respectively.

interface.name: service_claim_v1

description.summary: An active claim over a service name

interface.description: This interface represents an active claim over a service name. This object is assigned a service identifier that is unique across concurrent compositor instances and must not be reused by a compositor during its lifetime.

event.name: claimed
event.description:
Report that the service claim succeeded. This event provides the unique service identifier allocated for this claim to the client, as well as the claimed name.
After this event is received, no more events will be sent for this object. The claim is valid until this object is destroyed or its owning client disconnects.

event.name: failed
event.description:
Failed to create a service claim for the given service name. This may be because the name is invalid, or it has already been claimed by another client.
After this event is received, no more events will be sent for this object.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Request this service claim is released. The service name will become available for claim by other clients. The service identifier representing this claim is no longer valid after this request is made.

interface.name: service_lookup_v1

description.summary: A result of a service lookup

interface.description: This interface represents the result of a service lookup. The main purpose of a lookup is to find the service identifier for a service claim by name.

event.name: found
event.description:
The lookup succeeded, the requested service name has been claimed by another client and a service identifier has been allocated for it.
After this event is received, no more events will be sent for this object, and it can be destroyed safely.

event.name: not_found
event.description:
The lookup failed, this is likely because the service name has not been claimed by a client yet.
After this event is received, no more events will be sent for this object, and it can be destroyed safely.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Requests that the lookup object be destroyed. If the lookup is not yet complete, it will be cancelled, suppressing any results.
